title: What is a browser agent? Definition and example | 50agents
description: A browser agent is an AI agent that works in a web browser: it opens pages, reads, clicks and fills in forms on sites with no app to connect.
definition: A browser agent is an AI agent that works in a web browser: it opens pages, reads them, clicks and fills in forms.
It suits websites with no app or API to connect, like a supplier's portal.

example.ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
example.why: Pricing pages have no app to connect, so it reads them in a browser.

build.name: Price watch
build.line: competitor pricing pages, read every morning
does: Opens each pricing page you name
Compares prices with the last run
Leaves a report of what changed
